page.overview:
What is Ankhapur?

Ankhapur was a city located in the Lake of Steam region on the southern edge of interior Faerûn.

The city was primarily known for its pearl industry, which involved many of its citizens.

There were a number of tressym in the city. Curiously, on the day before Highsummer each year, every tressym in the city mysteriously disappeared only to return three days later.

Ankhapur was originally settled as a military outpost of the Jhaamdath Empire around -5000DR, and is the only such city along the Lake of Steams northern coastline to have remained continuously settled throughout the ages. Unlike all other cities along the Arnaden, Ankhapur alone was not completely resettled by Calishites, having retained their Jhaamdathan roots and appearing more like a city of the Vilhon Reach or Tethyr. In 1366 DR, Manferic III ruled Ankhapur with an iron hand and a touch of sadism. He became a lich and sought to inhabit the body of Janol Famisso, a bastard son of his. In his attempt, Manferic killed his other heirs while controlling Janol's body in order to inherit the throne from himself. However, thanks to a cleric of Lathander, Lissa, and others, Manferic was destroyed by Janol and his allies.
